blurb: Guests board the vessel at the Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum in St. Michaels to enjoy narrated historical cruises or evening river cruises along the Miles River. The cruises provide views of historic mansions and wildlife and include a full snack bar on board. Private charters and group bookings are available for various events and school groups.
extraNote: No refunds after purchase; rescheduling allowed with 2-hour notice for emergencies · Full refund or reschedule if cruise canceled due to weather or mechanical issues · Cruises run in rain; captain may cancel for lightning or high winds · Docked at the Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum, St. Michaels Harbor · April through November
